subject: math

objective.text: Add multi-digit numbers with the standard algorithm. Solve word problems with tape diagrams.

explanations.title: Standard addition algorithm
explanations.text: Write the numbers one above the other with the places lined up. Add the ones first, then the tens, then the hundreds, and so on, moving left.

explanations.title: Regroup 10 of a unit
explanations.text: Bundle 10 of one unit as 1 of the next larger unit. Write the 1 in the next column.

explanations.title: One digit in each column
explanations.text: Do not write two digits in one column. 13 tens is 1 hundred and 3 tens.

explanations.title: Tape diagram
explanations.text: A tape diagram shows the parts and the whole. A bracket marks the whole. A letter stands for the unknown number.

explanations.title: Variable
explanations.text: When a letter stands for an unknown number, we call the letter a variable.

explanations.title: Answer statement
explanations.text: Write a sentence that tells the answer. Use the words and the context of the problem.

explanations.title: Multiply tens by tens
explanations.text: 3 tens times 4 tens is 12 hundreds, not 12 tens.

examples.title: 3,134 plus 2,493
examples.text: 4 ones plus 3 ones is 7 ones. 3 tens plus 9 tens is 12 tens, so bundle 10 tens as 1 hundred. 1 hundred plus 4 hundreds plus 1 hundred is 6 hundreds. 3 thousands plus 2 thousands is 5 thousands. The sum is 5,627.

examples.title: 40,762 plus 30,473
examples.text: 2 ones plus 3 ones is 5 ones. 6 tens plus 7 tens is 13 tens, which is 1 hundred 3 tens. The sum is 71,235.

examples.title: The Lane family trip
examples.text: 907 miles plus 297 miles is m. m is 1,204. The family drove 1,204 miles in the second week.

misconceptions.label: Multiplies tens by tens and keeps tens
misconceptions.description: The child says 3 tens times 4 tens is 12 tens.
detection_signals: says 12 tens for 3 tens times 4 tens
misconceptions.response_text: Multiply the numbers: 3 times 4 is 12. A ten times a ten is a hundred. So the answer is 12 hundreds.

A row for the regrouped 1 above the next column
A line and the sum row

states_or_frames: A column with 10 or more regrouped
Sum complete with the tape diagram labeled
